messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: new policy or posting messages: tags
parts:
Dear users of the lavaan discussion group:

As suggested by many of you, I enabled the 'tags' feature of this discussion group.
This means that each post needs to get at least on 'tag' (or keyword). This will (hopefully) create more structure to the
long list of messages.

How does it work: at the bottom of the text box, you can add (up to 14) tags/keywords.

Some suggestions are:

general multigroup multilevel categorical measurement invariance growth syntax error
warning non-convergence lavTestLRT documentation bug reproducibility  fit cfi rmsea
robust standard-errors test-statistics satorra-bentler missing

but you can add your own.

I consider this an experiment. If it turns out that this more annoying than helpful, I will shut it off again.

Yves.
